newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-La Todena rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-La Todena rated a buy.

text.p: Philippine Asia Equity said it has recommended a buy on liquor firm La Tondena Distillers Inc (LTDI) following a strong turnover performance in January.

In a report released on Friday, analyst Gina Roa-Dipaling said that La Tondena posted net sales of 704 million peso in the first month of the year or 33 percent over the level registered in the same period last year.
She said January and February are usually slow months for the company.

"1997 will be a good year for LTDI. Growth in sales volume is expected to return to normal from 5.0 percent growth last year for Ginebra San Miguel (its flagship product) to around 10 to 12 percent," she said.
The softening of molasses prices should help improve margin growth, she added.
La Todena closed unchanged at 69.50 pesos on Friday.
